messages:
anya: Flagging a customer case: stream truncation -> route swap -> duplicate toolcall billing. Minimal repro attached.
kevin: Is this the ephemeral-session-reset problem again? Any traces showing headers cleared on route change?
dina: Trace: client->edge(us-west)->router(swap->us-east/gpu8bit) -> session reset -> client replay. Logs: ```23:05:10 stream eof seq=1024; wrote toolcall id=tlc-77; 23:05:11 route swap; ephemeral headers cleared; 23:05:11 reconnect replay -> toolcall id=tlc-77-R1```
anya: Options: require client idempotency token (good), or server fingerprinting fallback. We can't mandate client changes immediately.
kevin: Propose idemp_fingerprint = sha256(tool_name + normalized_payload). Dedupe provisional charges when fingerprint matches, same customer, and previous event is PROVISIONAL. Suppress by recording a suppression record, not deleting events.
dina: Add guard: only apply when event came after stream EOF + immediate reconnect (<500ms) or route-swap marker. That reduces false positives for concurrent legit calls.
ops-bot: Add feature-flag "idemp_fingerprint_dedupe" and per-customer opt-out tag `no_server_dedupe`.
console-team: UX asks: show "Suppressed (heuristic)" badge, link to raw events, and a "Request audit" button that files billing ticket. Also allow filtering suppressed items.
anya: Telemetry: emit dedupe.fingerprint, dedupe.reason, dedupe.suppressed boolean, and dedupe.trace_id. Keep raw events immutable for replay.
kevin: Alerts: suppression_rate > 0.5% of retries or confirmed_charge_delta increases after enabling. Backfill fingerprints for last 7 days to validate collision rate before suppression.
dina: Edge-case note: suppression only affects billing events, not tool execution. If retry actually ran downstream, we'll still have two executions; suppression won't hide executions. Document clearly.
ops-bot: Ticket RW-8991 created: "idemp-fingerprint dedupe for retry-induced provisional charges". Labels: billing, eng-platform, telemetry, console.
anya: I'll coordinate the backfill and RFC. DINA: server patch + canary. KEVIN: telemetry + dashboards. Console-team: UI prototype.
dina: ETA server patch + tests 2w. kevin: dashboards 4 days. console-team: mock in next sprint.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-27 14:00 UTC (5% traffic) with monitoring hooks.
anya: Thanks all, follow-ups in RW-8991.
